title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the read naming no package withholds a customization pair's row of a name every holder of which is disabled (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_
Fixes #32814

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill and no doc teaches what the read naming no package answers at a member only a customization pair stores (`skills/**` and `content/docs/**` grepped for disabled packages: the hits are action and component `disabled` predicates, package lifecycle references and a release page); `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` already says a disabled module is hidden.

> **BREAKING** (ADR-0087 `registered`, semantic entry `disabled-holder-pair-row-bare-read-withheld`): the read naming no package, at a member only a customization pair (an App's `PACKAGE.custom`) stores, for a name every installed package holding it has disabled, answers the holder's withheld item (404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) where it served the pair's row. First-party count: 0. Remedy: re-enable a holder.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：某个名字（如 email_template `welcome`）的所有持有包都被停用、而某个语言成员（如 `fr-FR`）只存在于 App 定制配对包（`APP.custom`）的存储行里时，不带 `?package=` 的裸读（`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?member=`、`/layers`、执行读）现在答 404（停用持有者的“已隐藏”条目），以前会把那行配对定制返回出来。
- 为什么改：停用包的内容不应再被服务（专题红线 1，ADR-0150 D3）；带 `?package=APP.custom` 的精确读早已答 404，裸读却还漏出这一行。裸读以前只在“什么都没读到”时才判断持有者是否全部停用，读到配对行就直接返回了。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（narrowing，BREAKING，metadata-protocol patch，Metadata-protocol: none——作者能写的东西没有变），第一方 0 处。重新启用持有者、同一配对另有启用的持有者、持有者自己的行、无包行、精确读，答案都不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `isHoldersPairRow` 与 `readMetaItemFace` 里 `withheldHolder` 的三元判断（风险 hunk：裸读分支新增的判定）；`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#32814]` 组；`packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#32814]` 组。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32814`，预期 12 个全部通过：两种保存顺序 × 是否水合 × 模块/App 自身作持有者，裸读都答 404；重新启用后与两持有者 CONTROL 仍返回配对行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`readMetaItemFace` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, the body behind `getMetaItem` and `getMetaItemForExecution`) judges whether every package holding the name is disabled (`disabledOnlyHolderOf`, #32183) only when the read reached nothing, or, on an exact read, when it reached a row not stored under the named package (epic ruling R4-B). On the read naming no package, a row it did reach was returned unjudged. For a bundled type such as `email_template`, the member a customization pair adds (an App pair's `fr-FR` row beside a module's shipped `en-US`) is reached that way, so with the module disabled the bare read served the pair's row, while `?package=APP.custom` at the same member already answered the withheld item (ruling R4-C, `disabledExactAddressHolder`).

Now, on the read naming no package, a row stamped with a customization pair (`pairsOf`) of a package holding the name (`isHoldersPairRow`) is judged the same way: when every holder is disabled, the answer is the holder's withheld item, the answer the same read gives with no row stored. A pair row is bound over the holders it is a pair of and is never a holder of its own (#32354 contract review N2, #32408), so it is withheld with them.

| state (member `fr-FR` stored only under `APP.custom`) | door, naming no package | FROM `main` e540baf88 | TO this head | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| the only holder (a module of the App, or the App itself) disabled; row saved before or after the disable; hydrated or not | plain read `?member=fr-FR` | 200, the pair's row | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (protocol: no item, `packageId` = the holder) | narrowing |
| the same | `/layers?member=fr-FR` (`RestServer`) | 200, the pair's row as the effective layer | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | narrowing |
| the same | execution face (`getMetaItemForExecution`) | the pair's row | no item | narrowing |
| the holder enabled again | all of the above | the pair's row | the pair's row | none (CONTROL) |
| two modules of the App hold the name, one disabled, either registration order | plain read | the pair's row | the pair's row | none (CONTROL) |
| both modules disabled | plain read | 404 | 404 | none |
| no row stored, holder disabled | plain read | 404 | 404 | none (CONTROL) |
| a package-less row, a row of a package outside the App, the holder's own row | plain read | as before | as before | none (not judged here, measured) |

The other doors of the same name were measured but are outside this card: the list reads (`getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemsForExecution`) still list the pair's row while every holder is disabled (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`, an E1 hot file this order may not edit; see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` `[#32814]` at the end of the file (no overlap with the `[#32561]` block #33251 edits): 8 negative pins (module of the App / the App itself × row before / after the disable × hydrated or not) asserting no item, `packageId` = the holder, no byte of the pair's row, and no item on the execution face, each followed by a re-enable CONTROL; 2 pins that the answer with the pair's row stored equals the answer with none (the envelope's `version` left out, see Acceptance notes); 2 CONTROLs (two modules of the App, both registration orders: one enabled serves the pair's row, both disabled withhold it).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` `[#32814]` at the end: the plain read and `/layers` at the member answer 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` in both save orders, then the pair's row once re-enabled; CONTROL: no row stored answers the same 404.

## Acceptance notes

- **Metadata-protocol: none, by measurement.** The card expected `narrowed`. Nothing an author can write is refused, re-shaped or changes meaning: the pair row is still accepted on save and served again on re-enable. Only what a read serves while every holder is disabled moves, the same classification #33130 (the served-set sibling) declared. The narrowing is carried by `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the BREAKING banner and the registered semantic entry.
- **Not moved on purpose: a package-less row.** With the only holder disabled, a package-less `fr-FR` row is still served by the bare read (measured on `main` and on this head). `servedRowHolderOf` documents that a name with a package-less row is "judged as before" (a customization of no one holder); whether it is the disabled holder's customization is not ruled, so it is reported, not guessed.
- **List reads.** `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItemsForExecution` with no package list the pair's row while every holder is disabled (measured on `main` e540baf88, both save orders). Reported for a separate card; `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` is a hot file for this order.
- **Envelope `version`.** The protocol's withheld envelope keeps the `version` of what the read reached on every withheld arm (a disabled holder's own stored row keeps its row's version, measured), so the no-row equality pin compares everything else. No door serves it: both REST doors answer 404.
- **`/published`** takes no member, and the bare read at the canonical member was already withheld on `main`; not moved.

## Verification

Premise, on `origin/main` e540baf88 (a probe over the same fixtures, not committed): with the only holder disabled, the bare read at `fr-FR` served the pair's row in all four save/hydration orders, for a module of the App and for the App itself; with no row stored it answered the holder's withheld item. Every other probed state (holder enabled, two holders, a package outside the App, a package-less row, the holder's own row) answered the same on this head as on `main`.

<details><summary>Pins and ablation (one mutation: the bare-read arm of the new judgment replaced with a constant false)</summary>

- Fix head 51b589e8, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32814`: `Tests 12 passed`.
- Ablated (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`): `Tests 10 failed | 2 passed` — the 8 withheld pins and the 2 no-row equality pins red, the 2 two-module CONTROLs green.
- Restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` and whole-tree clean): `Tests 12 passed`.
- REST, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`: `Tests 44 passed (44)`. Ablated: `-t 32814` `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed` (both save orders red, the no-row CONTROL green). Restored: `Tests 3 passed`.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`, `@objectstack/objectql typecheck`, `@objectstack/rest typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` each.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (86 families) run locally, reconciled with `--ran`: `86 derived, 84 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The two exit 3 (prerequisite: a full workspace build): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:type-check-debt`. Every other family exit 0.
